title: Choo-choo train, the benchmark's one-line prompt
model: Purple Skippy: Claude Code on Skippy Core's coder (Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, MTP, Q8), local and free
verdict: Reads clearly as a steam train: black boiler with white bands, a tall stack puffing smoke, a cowcatcher, track with sleepers, a station with a red roof and gold trim, a water tower, trees. Short of the frontier builds: the wheels lie beside the track instead of under the engine, the passenger cars are flat slabs with no windows, a few blocks float, and most of the plate is empty ground.
